items.title: Ghost SPN Attack Lets Hackers Conduct Stealthy Kerberoasting Under the Radar
items.description: A sophisticated evolution of Kerberoasting dubbed the “Ghost SPN” attack that allows adversaries to extract Active Directory credentials while erasing all traces of their activity, rendering traditional detection models effectively blind to the intrusion. The attack revealed by Trellix security researchers utilizes delegated administrative permissions, creating temporary exposure windows.…

items.title: Linux Ransomware Pay2Key Attacking Servers, Virtualization Platforms, and Cloud Environments
items.description: Linux has long been considered a more secure operating system than Windows, but that reputation is being tested. A ransomware group known as Pay2Key, attributed to Iranian threat actors, has developed a Linux variant that is actively targeting organizational servers, virtualization hosts, and cloud workloads.
